# TildaZ v0.9.5

**Screens full of combining characters no longer crash, flicker or lose glyphs.**

- Output with thousands of distinct combining-character clusters used to crash TildaZ on
  macOS, or flicker and drop glyphs on every platform when the glyph atlas filled up
  mid-frame. The atlas now grows on demand and what was already drawn is kept.
  ([#578](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/578),
  [#584](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/584),
  [#586](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/586),
  [#529](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/529))
- A first launch without a config file now has its window shortcuts — new tab, copy, paste,
  split — instead of none until the next start.
  ([#620](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/620))
- Programs using the kitty keyboard protocol with "report all keys" now get letters, Enter
  and lone modifier presses as `CSI u` on Windows and macOS as well as Linux, and Windows
  shows the pending dead key at the cursor like the other platforms already did.
  ([#602](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/602),
  [#636](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/636),
  [#606](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/606),
  [#530](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/530))
- Linux: a config error is shown on screen instead of exiting silently, the window sits
  flush against the screen edge at fractional scales, and unplugging and replugging the
  only keyboard or mouse no longer leaves TildaZ without input on sway and Hyprland.
  ([#577](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/577),
  [#619](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/619),
  [#347](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/347))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.9.5-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.9.5-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.9.5-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.9.5-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.9.5-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.9.5-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.9.5-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.9.5-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
